note: NEWWORLD-PRIME (PASS 97, 2026-09-14). Additive family, same reason as pass77, pass79, pass84, pass85 and pass87: the Pass 66 masters choreography is digest-pinned by the retained production gate, so a new arena rides beside it rather than rewriting accepted history. This is the AUTHORING recipe only - no capture has been run against it yet, which is why src/ui/menu-preview-video.ts still declares mediaAvailable false and the card renders PREVIEW STANDBY. The orbit is fitted to NEWWORLD_PRIME_ARENA_BOUNDS (80 x 92 m, src/newworld-prime-arena.ts): radius 40 x 46 is the half-extent of that box, so the long axis of the sweep is the north-south long axis of the horseshoe loop road. The 30 m altitude clears the map's tallest authored mass (the ~6.5 m two-storey house roof, see src/graphics-refinement.ts) by the same margin nuketown2's 30 m clears its two-storey houses. The phase opens the pass down the loop road between the west teal and east yellow houses with the school bus + semi-trailer holding the centre of frame, rather than over a spawn apron.
